model: MobileNetV2 (torchvision, ImageNet-pretrained, fine-tuned last 3 feature blocks)
trained_on: Google Colab T4 GPU session, driven via colab CLI (colab exec)
known_limitations: Validation split is a random hold-out from the SAME PlantVillage lab-image distribution as training — this accuracy measures in-distribution generalization only, not real-field-photo generalization. See decisions/0018-disease-cnn.md for why real-field accuracy is expected to be materially lower.
Only 4 of 38 classes' crops (apple, corn/maize, grape, orange) are in AGRO MIRAI's 22-value crop_type enum.
No per-disease severity ground truth; risk_level is a confidence-based heuristic, not a learned severity signal — see disease_cnn_labels.py.
